questions.question: Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the* signs and balance the given equation. 35 * 5 * 7 * 2 * 19 = 42
questions.questionHtml:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs to sequentially replace the* signs and balance the given equation.

35 * 5 * 7 * 2 * 19 = 42
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

The equation solved with the help of the BODMAS Rule:

Given: 35 * 5 * 7 * 2 * 19 = 42

Option 1) ×, ÷, -, +

⇒ 35 × 5 ÷ 7 - 2 + 19 = 42

⇒ 35 × 0.71428 - 2 + 19 = 42

⇒ 25 - 2 + 19 = 42

⇒ 44 - 2 = 42

⇒ 42 = 42

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 2) ÷, ×, +, +

⇒ 35 ÷ 5 × 7 + 2 + 19 = 42

⇒ 7 × 7 + 2 + 19 = 42

⇒ 49 + 2 + 19 = 42

⇒ 70 ≠ 42 

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) +, -, +, -

⇒ 35 + 5 - 7 + 2 - 19 = 42

⇒ 42 - 7 - 19 = 42

⇒ 42 - 26 = 42

⇒ 16 ≠ 42

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) ÷, ×, -, -

⇒ 35 ÷ 5 × 7 - 2 - 19 = 42

⇒ 7 × 7 - 2 - 19 = 42

⇒ 49 - 2 - 19 = 42

⇒ 21 ≠ 42

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.solution:

Solve with the help of the BODMAS Rule:

Given: 729 × 81 ÷ 20 + 16 − 6 = 50

Option 1) 6 and 20, × and ÷ 

After replacing the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 729 ÷ 81 × 6 + 16 − 20 = 50

⇒ 9 × 6 + 16 − 20 = 50

⇒ 70 - 20 = 50

⇒ 50 = 50

⇒ LHS = RHS

Option 2)  20 and 50, + and − 

After replacing the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 729 × 81 ÷ 50 - 16 + 6 = 20

⇒ 729 × 1.62 - 16 + 6 = 20

⇒ 1180.98 - 16 + 6 = 20

⇒ 1186.98 - 16 = 20

⇒ 1170.98 ≠ 20

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

After replacing the sign and number we get the:

⇒ 729 + 81 ÷ 20 × 50 − 6 = 16

⇒ 729 + 1.62 × 50 - 6 = 16

⇒ 729 + 81 - 6 = 16

⇒ 810 - 6 = 16

⇒ 804 ≠ 16

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 16 and 20, + and ÷

⇒ 729 × 81 + 16 ÷ 20 − 6 = 50 

⇒ 729 × 81 + 0.8 - 6 = 50

⇒ 59049 + 0.8 - 6 = 50

⇒ 59049.8 - 6 = 50

⇒ 59043.8 ≠ 50

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error. Has Gita any previous knowledge of work with junior colleagues?
questions.questionHtml:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Has Gita any previous knowledge of work with junior colleagues?
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is option 4) i.e. 'work.'

 

Key Points 

  • The error lies in the part 'work.'
  • We can note that the preposition 'of' is used before the word 'work,' which is a verb.
  • The word that must come after 'of' should be the object of the preposition 'of'. Hence, a gerund (working) must be placed after it.
  • A gerund is a verb that ends in '-ing' and functions as a noun or object.
  • Therefore we need to use the gerund form of the verb 'work'  which is 'working' after the preposition 'of.'
  • Therefore in the given sentence, we need to use 'working' in place of 'work' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
  • Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct sentence: Has Gita any previous knowledge of working with junior colleagues?

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'powerful.'

Key Points  

  • Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:
    Word Meaning

    impressive If an object or achievement is impressive, you admire or respect it, usually because it is special, important, or very large. (यदि कोई वस्तु या उपलब्धि प्रभावशाली है, तो आप उसकी प्रशंसा या सम्मान करते हैं, आमतौर पर क्योंकि यह विशेष, महत्वपूर्ण या बहुत बड़ी है)
    powerful having a lot of strength or force. (बहुत अधिक शक्ति या बल होना)
  • The context of the sentence is that the engines of the monster trucks have enormous strength that they can easily pull a train coach.
  • According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank is "powerful."
  • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 4.
